svg.title: Socrates, About 470 to 399 BCE
svg.desc: A linear timeline from about 470 BCE to 399 BCE. Marks: birth in Athens, about 470 or 469; hoplite service at Potidaea, about 432 to 429; a cluster for Delium in 424, Aristophanes' Clouds in 423, and Amphipolis in 422; the trial and death in 399.

text.font-family: 'Liberation Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif
'Liberation Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: A linear scale. The year of birth is traditional. The three campaigns are the ones named in Plato's Apology.
